newsitem.title: USA: National Presto new products hurt results.
newsitem.headline: National Presto new products hurt results.

text.p: National Presto Industries Inc said Friday declines in sales and earnings in 1996 were due to several factors, among them lack of interest in new products.

"Degrees of acceptance ranging from indifference to total failure of three new products introduced in 1996..." hurt results, as did reduced sales of high margin products and changes in inventory procedures by important customers, company president Maryjo Cohen said in a news release.

Earlier Friday, the company reported net income of $14.7 million, or $2 a share in 1996, compared to $19.0 million, or $2.61 a share a year ago. Net sales fell to $106 million in 1996 from $120.2 million in 1995.
